jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

Our hubs are in Berlin, London and Tallinn, but we are open to hire remotely from Europe and United Kingdom.

What you’ll do:

  • Make an impact in a true product team with a large ownership scope.

  • Work with cutting-edge technologies (Go is the primary language; it’s okay if you’re willing to switch from another language) without a legacy codebase.

  • Work on improving the reliability of our API.

  • Deliver fast and often. We embrace an agile methodology with a retrospective and demo at the end of the two-week cycle.

  • Design, build and own event-driven, fault-tolerant, horizontally scalable distributed systems using a Microservice architecture powered by Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka and PostgreSQL.

It’s great if you have:

  • Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.

  • Experience in event-driven architectures, event streaming, and event sourcing systems.

  • Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).

You’re likely to be successful in this role if:

  • You're excited about fintech and building the financial infrastructure of tomorrow.

  • You work with the customer in mind.

  • You are a true team player and feel energized in diverse teams.

  • You're hungry to learn and eager to grow quickly.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

At Upvest, accurate and complete financial data is at the core of our strategic decisions. As a working student in our accounting department, you will play a vital supporting role in ensuring smooth operations and maintaining the integrity of our processes.

You will assist with invoice recognition and tracking, ensuring all invoices are correctly categorized. Your support in approval workflows will help route invoices to the appropriate stakeholders. You will also follow up on missing invoices, collaborating with suppliers or internal teams to ensure timely receipt. Additionally, you will perform ad hoc administrative tasks that contribute to the overall efficiency of the accounting team.

What you’ll do:

  • You support the recording and review of invoices via Payhawk and Oracle NetSuite.

  • You maintain the invoice entries for all entities, both electronically and by mail.

  • You assist with the management of our virtual credit cards and travel expense reports.

  • You support colleagues with regular tasks, such as monthly closings, preparation of regulatory reports, and investor reports.

  • You assist colleagues with project work, such as audits, internal reviews, and ISAE 3402 audits, Work Instruction Updates, Process Improvement Initiatives.

  • You support your accounting team in communication with internal and external stakeholders.

What you bring:

  • You are enrolled as a student in economics, finance, accounting, or a related field

  • Basic expertise in accounting and related processes

  • Good communication skills in English

  • A strong sense of ownership and responsibility

  • Keen attention to detail

  • Eagerness to deepen knowledge in accounting, processes, internal controls, and related areas

  • Interest in the banking and fintech market, curiosity about investing

  • Fluent German (both written and verbal) is required

  • Berlin-based candidates preferred.

It’s great if you have:

  • Initial work experience in a relevant field (e.g. accounting, audit, or advisory)

  • Knowhow of German (Banking) GAAP (HGB, RechKredV)

  • Worked with accounting or ERP systems before e.g. Oracle NetSuite

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits..

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As (Senior) Legal Counsel – Investment Operations, you are part of the legal infrastructure that keeps Upvest's post-trade engine running. You bring a granular understanding of clearing, settlement, and custody — and you use it to ensure that every transaction Upvest processes is legally sound, operationally resilient, and regulatorily defensible at scale.

Your mission is to safeguard Upvest's operating business as it scales across the EEA, UK, and Switzerland. Working within a high-performing legal team, you will be the go-to legal voice for everything that happens after a trade is executed — ensuring our post-trade infrastructure remains compliant, our counterparty relationships are properly governed, and our operational processes can absorb the demands of rapid growth.

What you’ll do:

  • Post-Trade Legal Coverage: Be the legal authority on Upvest's post-execution infrastructure. Advise on the legal framework governing clearing, settlement, and custody operations, ensuring our processes remain compliant with applicable regulation at every step of the transaction lifecycle.

  • Custody & Safekeeping: Own the legal framework around client asset protection and safekeeping obligations. Ensure Upvest's custody arrangements, including sub-custodian relationships. are structured, documented, and monitored to the highest regulatory standard.

  • Counterparty & Operational Contracting: Lead the negotiation and ongoing management of agreements with CCPs, CSDs, custodians, and other post-trade infrastructure providers. Maintain a contractual framework that is robust, scalable, and commercially sound.

  • Regulatory Navigation: Serve as the internal expert on post-trade regulation across EU and German law. Monitor and interpret developments across MiFID, WpDVerOV, CSDR, and MaRisk, and translate their implications into actionable guidance for Operations, Compliance, and Finance.

  • Operational Risk & Incident Support: Partner with Operations and Compliance to assess and respond to post-trade incidents, settlement failures, and operational risk events from a legal perspective. Develop playbooks that enable fast, legally defensible responses.

  • Legal Ops & Automation: Drive the modernisation of Upvest's legal function. Champion scalable contracting processes, AI-assisted review workflows, and documentation standards that keep pace with operational growth without sacrificing rigour.

What You'll Bring:

  • Qualification: At least 3–5 years post-qualification experience (PQE) in the financial services industry. At least one German legal qualification (Erste Juristische Prüfung).

  • Post-Trade Depth: Hands-on understanding of clearing, settlement, and custody mechanics across a range of investment products — at the level of a seasoned practitioner who has worked directly with CCPs, CSDs, or custodians.

  • Industry Background: Experience in a regulated investment firm, custodian bank, CSD, infrastructure provider, or fintech with a meaningful post-trade operating footprint.

  • Regulatory Expertise: Strong command of EU and German financial law relevant to post-trade operations (MiFID, CSDR, WpDVerOV, MaRisk). Exposure to UK (FCA) regulation or other European NCAs is a strong plus.

  • International Mindset: Familiarity with adapting legal frameworks across European markets, particularly where post-trade infrastructure and regulation diverges by jurisdiction.

  • Automation Advocate: Enthusiasm for streamlining the legal function through technology — whether tooling, AI-assisted review, or smarter process workflows.

  • Pragmatic and Direct: You focus on keeping the business running through clear-eyed legal judgement. You identify risk without creating paralysis, and give Operations and Compliance answers they can act on.

  • Languages: Professional fluency in English and German — essential for regulatory filings, custodian negotiations, and day-to-day stakeholder management.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Experience creating detailed client-facing collateral, including architecture diagrams, solution proposals and technical specifications, with rigorous attention to detail.

  • Business fluent (C1) in German, Spanish, French or Italian is beneficial.

About the role:

Germany's private pension system is being rebuilt from the ground up. From 1 January 2027, the Altersvorsorgedepot (AVD) replaces the Riester-Rente as the country's state-subsidised private pension and Upvest is building the operational infrastructure that lets fintechs and banks offer it to millions of savers.

Join us as an AVD Operations Intern and you'll be there before Day 1: helping design the processes, then running them once they go live. This is a rare chance to see a regulated financial product being built from a blank page, rather than inheriting one that already works.

  • Support day-to-day AVD operations: Help run the core processes that keep the product working, e.g. contract registration with the ZfA (Zentrale Zulagenstelle für Altersvermögen), contribution management, the annual bonus application (AZ01), and payment reconciliation. You'll learn how a state-subsidised pension product actually functions behind the interface.

  • Help build the playbooks: As we prepare for launch, we're writing the processes from scratch. You'll help document workflows, build step-by-step guides and error catalogues, and keep them current as the rules and our systems evolve; the foundations the team will scale on.

  • Support error handling and reconciliation: Work through recurring error cases from the ZfA, check that payments and records match, and help spot the patterns behind repeat issues so they can be fixed at the root rather than one at a time.

  • Support our client teams: Our partners' support teams field questions from their end-users about subsidies, transfers and payouts. You'll help prepare clear, accurate answers and learn to translate dense regulation into language a customer can act on.

  • Spot what should be better: You'll see every manual workaround first-hand. We want your view on what's slow, error-prone, or worth automating; and you'll have the room to say so.

Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

As the CASS Oversight Manager, you are responsible for ensuring that client money and custody assets held by Upvest Securities are protected, segregated and accounted for in full compliance with the FCA’s Client Assets Sourcebook (CASS).

You will act as the primary day-to-day authority on CASS, bridging the gap between complex regulatory requirements, our operational processes, our client’s needs and our scalable investment API. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, Client and Operations teams to ensure our client asset framework remains robust, evidenced and audit-ready, enabling Upvest to scale its financial infrastructure to millions of end-users while maintaining the highest levels of integrity and trust with regulators, clients, and partners.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the CASS oversight framework: Maintain and continuously improve Upvest's CASS risk assessment, controls matrix, policies and procedures across CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, providing clear guidance to the business on what is and isn't permitted.

  • Work with our B2B clients, sales and client impact teams to actively shape solutions and provide advice that enables Upvest to support engaging and accessible investing for millions of end users in a CASS compliant way.

  • Oversee reconciliations and client money calculations: Oversee daily client money calculations and internal and external reconciliations of client money and custody assets, ensuring breaks are investigated promptly, shortfalls are funded and root causes are addressed.

  • Manage breaches and regulatory reporting: Maintain the CASS breach register, assess materiality, drive remediation and support FCA notifications where required. Own the monthly CMAR submission and act as the primary contact for the annual CASS audit, closing out findings to completion.

  • Keep the CASS Resolution Pack live: Ensure the resolution pack is complete, current and retrievable within regulatory timeframes, and that it is updated whenever banks, custodians, key vendors or critical staff change.

  • Embed CASS into how we build: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess the client asset impact of new products, features and system changes, and to ensure our ledgers, payment flows and custody integrations do what the rules require by design.

  • Enhance governance and culture: Produce clear CASS MI for the board and risk committees, deliver CASS training across the organisation, and track FCA developments to assess their impact on Upvest.

  • Manage external relationships: Support due diligence and periodic reviews of banks, custodians, and maintain acknowledgement letters and mandate registers in the prescribed form. Feed into TISA and other appropriate forums to gain further industry insights.

What you bring:

  • Deep CASS Expertise: Thorough working knowledge of CASS 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10, including client money calculations, reconciliation methods, acknowledgement letters, resolution pack requirements and the SMCR context in which the SMF18 operates.

  • Hands-on Client Asset Experience: Several years in a CASS operations, oversight or audit role in practice or at a broker, platform, custodian or wealth manager, with practical experience of breach handling, CMAR reporting and CASS audits.

  • Regulatory Analysis Skills: Proven experience in interpreting FCA rules and guidance and translating them into clear actionable operational procedures and controls.

  • Stakeholder Management: Strong communication of regulatory requirements to internal and external stakeholders, including engineering and product teams, external auditors and third-party custodians and banks.

  • Self-Starter Mentality: A highly organised approach with the ability to work independently, prioritise appropriately, and thrive under pressure, particularly around reporting and audit deadlines.

It’s great if you have:

  • Qualifications: Relevant industry certifications such as CISI Client Assets Specialist qualification, an accounting or audit background, or equivalent professional certification in a related discipline.

How we Upvest in you:

  • Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

  • Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

  • Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

  • Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

  • Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

  • Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values:

  • Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

  • Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

  • Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
À propos de nous

Chez Upvest, notre mission est de rendre l’investissement aussi simple que dépenser de l’argent. Upvest permet aux entreprises de proposer une large gamme de produits d’investissement et la meilleure expérience en matière d’investissement sur les marchés de capitaux et d’épargne retraite. Notre Investment API s’intègre facilement, pour que les fintechs et les institutions financières puissent se concentrer pleinement sur leur cœur de métier.

Nous travaillons avec les principales fintechs et institutions financières européennes, comme DKB, Revolut, N26 et Raisin. Fondée en 2017 par Martin Kassing, Upvest réunit aujourd’hui plus de 270 professionnels de plus de 70 nationalités. Upvest a levé 280 M€ auprès d’investisseurs de premier plan, dont BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital et Motive. Notre dernier tour de table de 105 M€, en mars 2026 et mené par Sapphire et Tencent, accélère notre croissance et nous permet d’offrir une expérience d’investissement haut de gamme.

Le poste

En 2027, Upvest lance le Plan d’Épargne en Actions (PEA) sur le marché français avec plusieurs fintechs de premier plan. Au sein de l’équipe Settlements & Transfers, vous intervenez sur l’ensemble de la chaîne post-marché des transferts de comptes-titres et de PEA : du traitement des instructions au dénouement chez Euroclear France, en passant par les relations avec les teneurs de compte, les dépositaires et les émetteurs.

Ce stage vous offre une exposition directe au post-marché français et européen dans une phase de lancement, avec de réelles responsabilités dès les premières semaines.

Vos missions

  • Transferts entrants et sortants : Prendre en charge les transferts de comptes-titres (CTO) et de PEA avec les banques et courtiers en France et en Europe, de la réception de la demande jusqu’au dénouement des titres et des espèces.

  • Relations contreparties et clients : Assurer une communication fluide avec les contreparties (banques, courtiers, dépositaires) et nos clients, et piloter le suivi des demandes et des relances.

  • Contrôles et réconciliations : Vérifier les positions titres et espèces, rapprocher les mouvements avec notre dépositaire et analyser les écarts.

  • Gestion des suspens et des anomalies : Analyser les instructions non dénouées ou rejetées, en identifier l’origine et coordonner leur résolution avec les contreparties et les équipes internes.

  • Fiscalité du PEA : Contrôler et intégrer les bordereaux d’information (BI) afin de garantir la continuité de l’historique fiscal du plan.

  • Titres au nominatif : Traiter les opérations sur titres nominatifs (conversions, inscriptions, radiations).

  • Reporting et amélioration continue : Suivre activement les SLA et les KPI, rédiger les procédures et identifier des pistes d’automatisation.

Votre profil

  • Formation : Master 1 ou 2 en finance, banque, économie ou droit (école de commerce, d’ingénieurs ou université), en année de césure ou jeune diplômé(e) d’un Master, avec possibilité de signer une convention de stage. Pour les M1 : votre établissement doit permettre un stage de 6 mois à temps plein (semestre intégré ou dispense de cours).

  • Langues : Français langue maternelle (indispensable) et anglais courant.

  • Expérience : Une première expérience en banque, back-office, middle-office ou opérations titres est un réel atout, tout comme une connaissance du PEA, du post-marché ou d’Euroclear France.

  • Motivation : Un véritable intérêt pour les marchés de capitaux et les opérations post-marché.

  • Esprit d’analyse : Rigueur, sens du détail et goût pour la résolution de problèmes complexes.

  • Outils : Bonne maîtrise d’Excel / Google Sheets ; la connaissance de SQL/Python est un plus.


Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Un travail à fort impact : Nous construisons l’infrastructure qui portera l’avenir de l’investissement en Europe. C’est complexe, ambitieux et porteur de sens. Vous travaillerez avec des technologies modernes et créerez quelque chose de totalement nouveau, sans système hérité et sans limites.

  • Moments d’équipe : Participez aux événements d’entreprise comme UpFest, les dîners, les offsites et la fête de fin d’année, pour échanger avec vos collègues et célébrer nos réussites.

  • Inclusion : Nous nous engageons pour une culture où chacun a sa place et s’épanouit. Nos groupes de ressources pour les employés favorisent l’inclusion et les liens, comme Upfem Black at Upvest, Up&Out et UpVergent.


Nos valeurs

  • Make it easy for others. Nous simplifions le complexe et agissons avec les meilleures intentions.

  • Own the outcome. Nous sommes proactifs, rapides et confiants pour faire avancer les choses : le progrès avant la perfection.

  • Rise to the challenge. Nous visons haut et repoussons les limites. Nous restons curieux, apprenons et célébrons nos réussites ensemble.

  • Tell the story. Nous commençons par le « pourquoi ». Nous sommes transparents et partageons nos connaissances pour inspirer les autres.

Upvest garantit l’égalité des chances. Nous célébrons la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous. À compétences égales, tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

    • Lead commercial negotiations for live clients, including pricing

About the role:

Own the go-to-market for Europe's next investment markets

We aim high at Upvest. Over the last years we have built one of Europe's most relevant B2B fintechs: an Investment API on top of a self-developed core banking engine, with full regulatory licences and investment operations included. Germany and the UK are proven, with more than 20 clients live and over 110 million trades processed in 2025. Our licences are passported across 20+ EEA countries, which means the infrastructure for the rest of Europe is already in place. From here we’re on a journey to enter market by market in Europe, starting with France, Spain, and Italy.

This is your opportunity to turn our foundation into a flywheel for new markets. You will own the go-to-market for continental Europe end-to-end: defining which client segments we go after first, from fast-growing fintechs to established banks, building the target list and the pipeline behind it, and shaping the commercial case that wins against local incumbents and against the instinct of large banks to build it all themselves.

Lead high-stakes sales and win complex deals with financial institutions

Our clients include the most ambitious fintechs and the most demanding financial institutions in Europe. Winning their business requires enterprise commercial rigour, deep domain knowledge, and genuine client partnership. Deals run over many months, involve procurement, risk, compliance and IT, and are won on substance rather than volume. Since inception we have been delivering on such high touch deals with clearly defined sales journeys, strong materials, and a unique approach now amplified by AI.

You will lead those deals personally before you lead them through others. That means owning the largest opportunities in your region yourself, from first conversation to signature, while bringing the discipline that makes the motion repeatable: rigorous qualification, value-based and consultative selling, predictable forecasting, and a clear view on where not to spend time. You use AI actively to increase your own coverage and later that of your team, and you feed what you learn from clients back into product, solutions, and marketing.

Attract, develop and lead a best-in-class sales team in European fintech

Building world-class financial infrastructure requires world-class people. At Upvest we put hiring excellence and people development front and centre. The Growth team today features talented, driven people coming from Europe's leading fintechs, financial institutions, and technology companies, with Sales working side by side with revenue ops, marketing, partnerships, and solutions engineering on shared targets.

With inspiring yet pragmatic and hands-on leadership you will build the European sales team around you. You will set the bar for the talent you hire, ramp new Account Executives fast, set and steer their targets, and coach them through cycles that few people have run before. You will be measured on what your team closes as much as on what you close yourself, and you will keep carrying a quota personally for as long as this stage of the business asks for it.

What you’ll do:

  • Real ownership of a region: This is a defining hire for our European expansion. You own commercial success for your markets, with Alexander, our Co-Founder Til Rochow, and the rest of senior leadership as your close sparring partners and supporters.

  • A product that gives you an unfair advantage: Our Investment API is genuinely differentiated, a full-stack B2B investment infrastructure crafted with the best product principles and most modern tech stack in the industry. It is live, regulated by BaFin and the FCA, and proven at scale with clients such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin.

  • A team that takes the work seriously: Upvest's Growth team, and the company around it, is one of a kind when it comes to combining impactful work with a collaborative and fun culture. You will have dedicated revenue ops, solutions engineering, marketing, and partnerships colleagues working with you on your deals, and strong practices around feedback, psychological safety, and team health.

  • The complexity and richness of financial infrastructure: Working at the intersection of API-first SaaS and regulated financial services, with clients ranging from hypergrowth fintechs to global banks, is one of the most strategic and commercially interesting places to be. Every client relationship and every deal teaches you something new. If you are intellectually curious about how financial markets and products are being rebuilt from the ground up, this is the role for you.

  • Flexibility with a European footprint: We are a Berlin- and London-headquartered company with a growing presence across Europe. We are equally open to candidates based in one of Europe's financial hubs, in particular Paris, Madrid, and Milan, who are willing to spend meaningful time in Berlin. What matters most is the quality of your leadership and the results you deliver.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in senior sales roles, including at least two years leading a team, within high-growth B2B technology and financial services. You have sold API-based enterprise SaaS into fintechs, banks, brokers or wealth managers, and you know financial infrastructure such as core-banking or securities processing.

  • A proven track record of closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions, and of building the foundations that make doing so repeatable. You have taken a sales team from first foundations to early scale, with a proven track-record of exceeding ambitious revenue targets

  • Genuine European reach: You have sold across several European countries, with direct experience in at least one of France, Spain or Italy, a strong network in the world of banking and finance

  • A modern approach to sales: customer-centric, value-based, data-driven, and AI-enabled. You have strong views on what great looks like, from qualification frameworks to CRM hygiene to how account plans and collaboration roadmaps have the highest impact and are enabled by and enhanced with AI, and you turn those views into standards the team works to.

  • Hands-on ownership with strategic foresight: You operate practically, think in second-order effects to get complex deals across the line, and you are genuinely comfortable carrying quota yourself at this stage rather than only managing others who do.

  • Outstanding people leadership: You hire exceptional people, develop them continuously, and create a non-hierarchical, inclusive and respectful environment where the best talent chooses to stay and grow. You lead with clarity, empathy, and high standards.

  • Fluent English plus native-level in either French, Spanish, or Italian. Investment domain knowledge, experience selling regulated products, and time at a tier-1 growth company are a strong plus.

  • Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

  • Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.
